name: photoreal-defect-sweep-2
description: Photoreal arc render-DEFECT sweep #2 of the default 4-room flat (Serangoon North Vista): poses NOT covered by photoreal-defect-sweep.json — bath2 fittings/door, bedroom2 window/door-wardrobe, main bedroom FCU/door, household shelter interior, kitchen close-ups (service-yard door, socket row, sink+tap), service yard at night, main bedroom at night with lamps, corridor east + a low grazing pose, living/dining toward the main door + DB box, and two orbit frames at golden hour (07:30/18:30) for the sun angle. 13:00 first, then 20:00 for the night set, realistic/capable. Every walk pose is followed by a guard step asserting eye height (within 0.1 m) and the walk cameras room (via floorPlan.rooms + a point-in-room test mirroring floorplan/types.ts:pointInRoom). Run with SHOT_GPU=1, url http://localhost:5200/.

steps.name: pose-corridor-low-skirting

steps.name: guard-corridor-low-skirting
steps.eval: (() => { const cam = window.__three.camera; const eyeExp = 1.2; const dy = Math.abs(cam.position.y - eyeExp); if (dy > 0.1) throw new Error('GUARD corridor-low-skirting: eye height ' + cam.position.y.toFixed(3) + ' not within 0.1 of 1.2'); const plan = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const room = (plan.rooms || []).find(r => r.id === 'corridor'); if (!room) throw new Error('GUARD corridor-low-skirting: room corridor not found in plan.rooms'); const pir = (r, x, z) => { if (r.polygon && r.polygon.length >= 3) { let inside = false; for (let i = 0, j = r.polygon.length - 1; i < r.polygon.length; j = i++) { const xi = r.polygon[i][0], zi = r.polygon[i][1], xj = r.polygon[j][0], zj = r.polygon[j][1]; const hit = ((zi > z) !== (zj > z)) && (x < ((xj - xi) * (z - zi)) / (zj - zi) + xi); if (hit) inside = !inside } return inside } const inMain = x >= r.origin[0] && x <= r.origin[0] + r.width && z >= r.origin[1] && z <= r.origin[1] + r.depth; if (inMain) return true; if (r.extension) { const ex = r.origin[0] + r.extension.offset[0], ez = r.origin[1] + r.extension.offset[1]; return x >= ex && x <= ex + r.extension.width && z >= ez && z <= ez + r.extension.depth } return false }; const x = cam.position.x, z = cam.position.z; if (!pir(room, x, z)) throw new Error('GUARD corridor-low-skirting: camera at (' + x.toFixed(2) + ',' + z.toFixed(2) + ') not inside room corridor'); console.log('[guard] corridor-low-skirting ok room=corridor eye=' + cam.position.y.toFixed(3)) })()
